name: Yuzawa (Akita, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yuzawa city emblem in green, blue and orange: two green leaf-like shapes flanking a blue crescent and an orange curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Yuzawa, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 18 July 2005.

features.role: Yuzawa city emblem — two green leaf-like shapes flanking a blue crescent and an orange curved stroke
